data.name: Settings.AppearanceDescription
data.value: Changes apply immediately. Arabic switches the interface to right-to-left.

data.name: Analyze.Subtitle
data.value: Review a contract against a playbook. Deterministic checks work offline; AI review is optional and consent-gated.

data.name: Analyze.Disclaimer
data.value: Not legal advice. Review by a licensed attorney required.

data.name: Settings.LanguageDescription
data.value: Choose the language used throughout DraftEngine. Changes apply immediately.

data.name: Settings.Subtitle
data.value: Connect DraftEngine to OpenAI and choose the defaults used for new contracts.

data.name: Settings.EncryptionWarning
data.value: Contract data is encrypted with your Windows user profile. Do not reset your Windows password or copy the database to another Windows account — the data will be unreadable. If you plan to change Windows users, export all contracts to DOCX/PDF first.

data.name: Settings.DataHandling
data.value: How your data is handled: when you use AI features (chat edits and AI polish), the contract text, your instructions and the intake answers are transmitted to OpenAI for processing. Contract content and chat history are stored encrypted on this computer. Do not use AI features for privileged or confidential client material you are not permitted to share with a third-party service.

data.name: Settings.ApiKeyShowHideAutomation
data.value: Show or hide the API key

data.name: Settings.ModelDescription
data.value: gpt-4o-mini is faster and cheaper; gpt-4o is more capable.

data.name: Settings.PrivacyDescription
data.value: Stays on this computer: contracts, intake answers, clause selections, chat history, settings and the API key (all encrypted with your Windows user profile). Sent to the AI provider only when you use an AI feature: the current contract text, your instruction, and the model name. No telemetry is collected.

data.name: Settings.HidePartyNames
data.value: Hide party names and addresses from AI

data.name: Settings.HidePartyNamesDescription
data.value: When on, real party names, addresses and e-mail addresses are replaced with tokens before every AI request and restored in the reply.

data.name: Settings.CustomEndpointDescription
data.value: Base URL, e.g. https://your-resource.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/… , a gateway, or http://localhost:11434/v1/ for Ollama or LM Studio.

data.name: Settings.ContractDefaultsDescription
data.value: These values pre-fill the new contract form. You can still change them per contract.

data.name: Settings.DefaultTermMonthsDescription
data.value: Whole number of months, between 1 and 120.

data.name: Settings.BackupDescription
data.value: A portable backup contains contracts, intake answers, clauses, versions, chat history and non-secret settings in one password-encrypted file (AES-256-GCM). It can be restored on another Windows PC. The password is never stored; if you lose it the backup cannot be opened. The OpenAI API key is not included.

data.name: Settings.BackupPasswordTooltip
data.value: Used only for this export or restore

data.name: Settings.ExportDataDescription
data.value: A readable, UNENCRYPTED copy for your own records or another tool. It includes contract text and intake answers; store it somewhere protected. The API key is never included.

data.name: Settings.ErrorBackupPasswordShort
data.value: Choose a backup password of at least 8 characters.

data.name: Settings.BackupSaved
data.value: Encrypted backup saved: {0} contracts, {1} clauses. Keep the password safe; it cannot be recovered.

data.name: Settings.ErrorBackupWrite
data.value: The backup could not be written. Check the destination and try again.

data.name: Settings.RestoreConfirm
data.value: Restoring replaces all current contracts, clauses, intake answers, chat history and versions on this computer. A pre-import backup is written first. Continue?

data.name: Settings.ErrorRestorePassword
data.value: Enter the password used when the backup was created.

data.name: Settings.RestoreDone
data.value: Backup restored: {0} contracts, {1} clauses. Restart the app if a page still shows old data.

data.name: Settings.ErrorWrongPassword
data.value: Wrong password, or the backup file was modified. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Settings.ErrorRestore
data.value: The backup could not be restored. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Settings.CsvWarning
data.value: This CSV export is NOT encrypted and includes contract titles, parties and intake answers. Store it somewhere protected. Continue?

data.name: Settings.JsonWarning
data.value: This JSON export is NOT encrypted and includes contract text, intake answers and chat history. Store it somewhere protected. Continue?

data.name: Settings.ExportDone
data.value: Data exported. The file is unencrypted; protect it or delete it when done.

data.name: Settings.ErrorExport
data.value: The export could not be written.

data.name: Settings.ConsentRevoked
data.value: AI consent revoked. AI editing is now blocked.

data.value: We couldn't update the AI consent setting. Please try again.

data.value: Please paste your OpenAI API key first.

data.name: Settings.ErrorConnectionTest
data.value: Something went wrong while testing the connection. Please try again.

data.name: Settings.ErrorTermRange
data.value: Term must be between 1 and 120 months.
